page.title: Turn any YouTube video into a Claude skill
page.sub: The free skill and the prompt from the reel. Claude takes in a YouTube video and writes what it teaches as a skill it can use again and again.
page.prompt_how: Do step 1 below first (install the skill in Claude Code). Then paste this into Claude Code with your video's link in the square brackets.
page.prompt_note: Long video? Add: only watch from [start time] to [end time].
page.tested_title: We ran it on three real videos

results.name: Three videos taken in: 88, 57 and 24 seconds (under 3 minutes in all)
Three skills written, then one content plan from all three
Podcasts, and many videos in one go

page.tested_text: We gave it three videos: Chris Voss's "Top 10 Most Powerful Negotiation Tips" (18:40, back in **88 seconds**), Alex Hormozi's "How to Grow an Audience if You Have 0 Followers" (6:53, 57 seconds) and GaryVee's "If I Started Social Media In 2026, I'd Do This" (7:49, 24 seconds). Claude wrote a skill from each. Then we asked it to use all three to write a content plan for Signal Service, and it gave three rules: **post every day and score the posting, not the views** (Hormozi); **teach the whole trick before the ask** (GaryVee); **ask with a question that is easy to answer** (Voss). **Not checked:** podcasts, a batch of videos in one go, and a computer with nothing installed (ours already had the tools it needs).
page.tip: **The tip:** if the words come back in another language, add: use the English captions. That happened to us on one video.

prompt: Use the watch skill on this video: [paste the YouTube link]. Watch this, learn what it teaches, and turn it into a skill that I can use forever. Save it as a skill in this project, with a short name. Then tell me in five lines what you learned and give me one example of how to use it.

followups.label: Use the skill
followups.prompt: Use the skill you just made on this: [describe your situation]. Give me the result ready to use, then one line on which part of the video it came from.
followups.note: Works best on a real task you have today.

followups.label: Combine several videos
followups.prompt: Use all the skills you have made from videos to write me one plan for: [your goal]. One rule from each video, and say which video each rule came from.
followups.note: This is how we got the Signal Service content plan from three videos.

followups.label: Check it against the video
followups.prompt: List every rule in the skill with the time in the video where it is said, so I can check it.
followups.note: The skill keeps timestamps, so you can jump to the moment and hear it yourself.

checklist_title: Set it up in five steps

checklist.title: Open Claude Code
checklist.detail: It is the Code tab in the Claude desktop app. The skill does not work in normal Claude chat, and Claude Code needs a paid Claude plan.

checklist.title: Install the Watch skill
checklist.detail: Paste this and tell Claude to install it: github.com/bradautomates/claude-video. It is free and open source, made by Bradley Bonanno.

checklist.title: Let it check your computer
checklist.detail: It needs three free tools (Python, ffmpeg, yt-dlp). On a Mac it offers to install them for you.

checklist.title: Choose how it watches
checklist.detail: With a free Google AI Studio key it sees picture and sound. With no key it reads the captions and a set of frames, which is what we used.

checklist.title: Paste the prompt with your video
checklist.detail: Then use the follow-ups to put the skill to work.

safety: **Check the skill before you rely on it.** Captions can mishear words, so read what Claude wrote against the video.
**The video belongs to its maker.** Use this to learn from it, not to copy or repost it.
**With a Google key, the video link is sent to Google.** With no key, everything stays on your computer.

email.tested: We gave it three videos (Chris Voss, Alex Hormozi and GaryVee). It took in all three in under three minutes (88, 57 and 24 seconds) and wrote a skill from each. The skill link, the prompt and the setup steps are on your guide page: plan.signalservice.ai/watch
email.safety: It runs in Claude Code (the Code tab), not normal Claude chat, and Claude Code needs a paid Claude plan. The skill itself is free.
